description: Find properties that are free for every night between checkIn and checkOut and can host the guests. Returns nightly price estimates, minimum-stay rules and booking links.

bedrooms.description: Only properties with exactly this many bedrooms (6 means 6 or more).

checkIn.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Check-in is from 15:00 Bali time.

checkOut.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Check-out is by 11:00 Bali time.

children.description: Number of children. Children count towards the guest limit.

features.description: Only properties with all of these features.

infants.description: Number of infants (ages 0-2). Infants do not count towards the guest limit.

name.description: Only properties whose name contains this text, e.g. "Kura".

pets.description: Number of pets. Only some properties allow pets.

pool.description: Only properties with a private pool, or with access to a shared pool.

name: search_stays
title: Search available stays
